## README.md
> **This dataset has moved.** It is now published, updated and extended as [Ireland INSPIRE Geospatial aid application (GSAA) dataset](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ie) in the [Harmonized Field Boundary Data](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data) catalog. The files here are no longer updated.

# Ireland GSAA

This data represents the outline shape of LPIS parcels as claimed under area based schemes. The dataset includes the crops claimed as part of the annual GSAA.
Yearly information provided through the beneficiary declaration.

- **Source data provider:** Ireland Department of Agriculture, Food and the Marine"
- **Converted by:** Ivor Bosloper
- **Homepage:** https://inspire.geohive.ie/geoportal/
- **License:** CC-BY-4_0
- **Projection:** EPSG:4258

--

### Columns

The Crop Field dataset has the following properties:

| Property               | **Data Type** | Description                |
|------------------------|---------------|----------------------------|
| id                     | string        | Identifier                 |
| crop_name              | string        | Crop description (Finnish) |
| determination_datetime | datetime      |                            |
